items.description: A small settlement located in the Orange Walk District of northern Belize. It serves as a quiet rural community centered around local agriculture.
Corozal Town is the administrative capital of the Corozal District, known for its scenic bay views and proximity to the Mexican border. The town features a blend of Belizean and Mestizo cultures.
San Jose is a village in the Orange Walk District, primarily inhabited by a large Mennonite population. It is well-known for its contribution to local farming and produce.
Santa Marta is a rural village found in the Orange Walk District, situated along the Philip Goldson Highway. It is a traditional community focused on small-scale farming.
Chan Chen is a village in the Corozal District, known for its proximity to archaeological sites and sugar cane fields. It maintains a strong community-based agricultural economy.
X-Pichil is a smaller settlement in northern Belize, reflecting the diverse cultural landscape of the Corozal and Orange Walk border regions.
Carmelita is a prominent village in the Orange Walk District, located at the junction of key highways leading to Belize City and Corozal. It serves as a vital transit point for northern travelers.
Unitedville is a village in the Cayo District, strategically placed between San Ignacio and Belmopan. It is a developing community benefiting from its position on the Western Highway.
Santa Rosa is a remote village in the Toledo District, predominantly inhabited by indigenous Maya communities. It focuses on traditional land cultivation and preserving ancestral practices.
San Pablo is a village situated in the southern Toledo District, known for its lush tropical surroundings and traditional way of life. It is part of the broader Maya heartland of Belize.
